description: A dense crowd of women with raised fists and open mouths, shouting, many holding white cloths aloft. Most wear headscarves and dark or muted 1940s-style coats and dresses. Behind them is a neoclassical building with columns and a large green-domed congress-style building under a dark, stormy sky. Painterly oil style, filling the full frame edge to edge. No visible text, frame or graphic content.
